name: SolaCliq
source: MarkCliq's live site (markcliq.com), read 2026-10-18. Where the app needs more than the site defines (status colours, field sizes), the additions are noted in each token's usage.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background (markcliq.com bg). Never pure white.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised areas on the surface: inputs, side panels, table bodies (markcliq.com panel).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, pressed rows, the track behind progress. Sits on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons (markcliq.com fg). 15.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders (markcliq.com muted). 5.0:1 on surface, 4.7:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between rows and sections (markcliq.com border). 1.2:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons, so controls stay visible (3.3:1). Addition for the app.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rust red (markcliq.com accent): the one primary action per screen, the current stage, links. As text 5.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind accent text: selected rows, the current stage's row, hover wash. Accent on it 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, as on markcliq.com. 5.7:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, completed, synced. Text on surface (5.9:1) or success-tint (5.3:1). Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success pills and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Flagged for review (capture far from site, weak GPS), waiting to sync. Text on surface (5.5:1) or warning-tint (4.9:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected, suspended, destructive actions, field errors. Text on surface (8.3:1) or danger-tint (7.1:1). Darker than accent so the two never read as one colour.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger pills and notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pending, waiting on someone else (org approval, an approval request). Text on surface (7.7:1) or info-tint (6.8:1).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info pills and notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 15.8:1 on surface.

fonts.files: Variable, weights 300-700. SIL Open Font License; bundled with both apps.
Regular and Bold. SIL Open Font License; bundled with both apps.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: As on markcliq.com: regular weight, uppercase, tight tracking and leading.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Admin page titles and the customer's install screen title.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Mobile screen titles, admin section titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Light running text as on markcliq.com. Field values use body at weight 400 so typed text reads in sunlight.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The first line of a list row or job. Sentence case so names stay readable.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Take photos of the panels, inverter and meter before you leave the site.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Assigned by the office on 18 Oct 2026
styles.usage: Second lines, help under fields, dense admin tables. Never smaller on mobile.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Space Mono, uppercase and widely tracked as on markcliq.com, for labels, buttons and every number.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, eyebrows, timestamps, IDs. markcliq.com uses 10px; 11px is the floor for phones outdoors.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Amounts, kW, counts, coordinates in rows and tables.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: The one headline figure on a screen: balance due, total cost.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between lines inside a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons (markcliq.com py-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter (markcliq.com px-6); between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons (markcliq.com px-10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Admin side gutter (markcliq.com md:px-12); top of a screen above its title.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major sections on wide admin pages (markcliq.com py-24).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, pills, rows, notices.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable in the mobile app.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact control height, admin website only (mouse).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width and offset.

motion.note: markcliq.com's editorial easing. Slow for hover and entrances; pressed states stay instant.

durations.name: duration-instant
durations.usage: Pressed state and other feedback to a tap.

durations.name: duration-slower
durations.usage: Entrances: a screen or panel arriving.
